generation.scope: All finite symmetric windows of opposite rank greater than six give torsion-free charge-four instanton sheaves with locally free double dual. At opposite rank ten every non-locally-free such window admits a binary edge and is nonregular. Thus the entire stable or nonstable rank-ten one-sided regular locus is contained in the locally free chart at both odd slots.

open_mathematics: Relate the two companion instanton monads by the middle differential of the commutative resolution. Study the rank-ten bundle locus through the evaluation of four sections and its quartic Grassmann map.
